messages:
Amal Carter: FYI — Falconcrest wants to onboard a tuned variant of `falcon-13b` for their enterprise POC. They claim they fine-tuned on clinical notes and require PHI controls. Main asks: model variant compatibility, latency SLO (~p95 < 150ms for chat), and an estimate for Dedicated pricing. Can eng + SE weigh in?
Lia Nguyen: Do we have the model artifact location? HF repo or private weights? Are they shipping an adapter or a full checkpoint?
Amal Carter: They said HF repo: https://huggingface.co/falconcrest/falcon-13b-tuned (access token will be shared via secure link). It's a full checkpoint + a small LoRA adapter.
Sophia Gomez: Thanks. Two quick things: (1) we need a regression eval against our standard medical prompt set, (2) quantization/variant recommendation — do we suggest an nf4 4-bit variant or stick to 8-bit? Customer cares about latency and cost.
Ryan Patel: Runtime notes: NF4 (4-bit) is supported on H100 with our optimized kernels. On A100 we fall back to 8-bit for NF4 due to kernel stability; that increases mem but latency can still be fine with batching. For p95 <150ms we need: smaller sequence lengths (<=512), continuous batching config, and KV cache warmers.
Ryan Patel: Example variant config we recommend (for Dedicated testing):
```
model_variant: falcon-13b-tuned-nf4
quantization: nf4
preferred_hardware: h100
max_batch: 8
max_sequence: 512
min_throughput_slo: 80 tokens/sec
```
Sophia Gomez: Also recommend a fallback variant `falcon-13b-tuned-8bit` for A100 regions. We should run a short A/B on quality with the medical eval set before approving NF4 in prod.
Ben Torres: Pricing ask — Falconcrest expects a ballpark today. For Dedicated (reserved) for a single variant with H100 preference, rough baseline: 2x H100 nodes ~ $25k/mo reserved + variable token throughput. If they want guaranteed p95 and burst capacity add ~15%. This is a starting point for the deal team.
Amal Carter: Noted. They will need DPA + KMS. Is Private/VPC required for PHI?
Lia Nguyen: For PHI we require Private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated with strict network controls and customer-managed KMS/HSM. Also need SOC2 + encryption at rest details in the security questionnaire.
Sophia Gomez: Action items: (1) Lia to run compatibility test on HF checkpoint and confirm quant support + any conversion steps (2) Ryan to create a test Dedicated profile with the NF4 variant on H100 and an A100 fallback (3) I'll assemble a short eval harness (10–20 prompts) to run regression.
Amal Carter: I'll get the HF access link and security questionnaire answers from the customer. Also will ask them for expected daily QPS and average prompt lengths.
deploy-bot: ticket #INF-7219 created: "Falconcrest — model onboarding + NF4 compatibility run" assigned to Lia, Ryan, Sophia.
Lia Nguyen: Quick note — if the LoRA adapter is small we can load it on top of our base weights without re-export but we should run a verification script: `python tools/verify_adapter.py --repo falconcrest/falcon-13b-tuned`
Ryan Patel: If Lia sees any custom ops in the repo (cuda kernels, patched attention) flag here. Those are the usual blockers for runtime execution.
Ben Torres: I'll call the buyer tomorrow about timeline and confirm whether they'd sign a month-long pilot vs annual reserved. If pilot, we suggest an on-demand setup in our hosted environment first (with private networking) to speed tests.
Amal Carter: perfect. Please drop ETA for tests by EOD so I can update the customer. :thumbsup:
